newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends steady in pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends steady in pre-holiday trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended on a steady note on Wednesday after a moderate trading session before the October 10 national holiday.
At the close, the Taiwan dollar was quoted at T$27.493 per U.S. dollar, versus Tuesday's T$27.495 finish.
Daily turnover was US$197.5 million, comparable to Tuesday's US$196.5 million.
In view of the coming holiday, the volume has turned out to be better than expected, which some dealers attributed to foreign funds buying.
"But commercial interest remained light," said a dealer.
Even the vaunted foreign funds gave the market little direction, he said.
While as much as US$20 billion of foreign funds has been approved to invest in Taiwan's equity market, only about half the amount is invested, the dealer said.
"After a few months, people don't take foreign funds as seriously as they used to," he said.
